chunks: Whatever is in H from ʿUmar ibn Abī Ziyād, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abī al-Khattab, from al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Ziyād.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, as an immediate transmitter in the chain
key_terms.الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ: a narrator in the transmission chain
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: a narrator in the transmission chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿUmar ibn Abī Ziyād in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿUmar ibn Abī Ziyād. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is foundational in hadith sciences for identifying the route of narration.
